name: get_symbol_complexity
description: Return cyclomatic complexity, nesting depth, and parameter count for a single symbol. Complexity data is stored at index time (requires jcodemunch-mcp >= 1.16 / INDEX_VERSION 7). assessment field: 'low' (1-4), 'medium' (5-10), 'high' (11+). Re-index the repo if all metrics show 0 (pre-1.16 index).

repo.description: Repository identifier (owner/repo or just repo name)

symbol_id.description: Full symbol ID as returned by search_symbols or get_file_outline.
